privacidad.introduccion: Before you start, this is what the app stores about your work.
privacidad.registra_texto: The room photos you take with the app's camera (start, finish and damages), start and end times, pauses with their reason, and the damages you report.
privacidad.no_registra_texto: Your location (the app does not use GPS), the photos in your gallery, or anything you do outside the app.
privacidad.para_que_texto: To verify the cleaning, calculate times and follow up on damages.
privacidad.quien_texto: Your supervisor and your company's administrator. No one from another company.
privacidad.cuanto_texto: Photos are deleted automatically after the number of days your company sets, except those of damages still open.
privacidad.fotos_texto: Photograph only the room. Avoid people, documents and guests' personal belongings.
privacidad.preguntas_texto: Ask your supervisor or your company's administrator.
